Outfit - Business Suit.description:
👕 Outfit: Business Suit
A dark, well-fitted business suit for offices, agencies and press events.

🖼️ Portrait only: changes how your character looks, never your Quirk or stats.
Outfit - Business Suit.traitNarrativeEffects:
Portrait: A charcoal or navy single-breasted two-piece suit over a white shirt, with a plain tie or an open collar, and polished black leather shoes; trousers or a knee-length skirt, whichever the character wears. Pressed and fitted. Cut openings for any established wings, tail or extra arms.

Portrait only: inventory and equipped items stay as they are. Keep the character's actual adult age, body plan and any Mutant features; the garment adds no Quirk effect, gear function, rank, license or affiliation. Respect the selected crop.
